refunds.title: Returns & Exchanges
refunds.body:
We take great care in crafting and packaging every order. However, we understand that sometimes things may not go as expected. Our returns policy is designed to be fair, transparent, and easy to navigate.

We do not offer returns or refunds on any products. However, exchanges are permitted only for the same product in cases of damage or manufacturing defects.

Eligibility for Exchanges

We accept exchange requests only under the following conditions:

  • The item was received in a damaged or defective condition due to a manufacturing fault
  • You received an incorrect item (wrong product or specification)
  • The request is raised within 24 hours of delivery with proper photographic or video evidence

As all our products are handmade and made to order, we do not accept returns or exchanges based on a change of preference or unmet expectations that were not clearly communicated at the time of purchase. We encourage you to review product details carefully before placing your order.

Exchange Process

Currently, we do not offer reverse pickup services. All requests will be processed only if they meet our eligibility criteria.

In such cases, customers are required to courier the product to our provided address through a nearby courier service. The courier charges will be borne by Shan Decors.

We are actively working on enabling doorstep return pickups and will introduce this service very soon. Thank you for your understanding and support. 🌿

For all exchange requests, contact us at: shandecor01@gmail.com

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.body:
Processing Times

Standard catalogue items are processed and dispatched within 5–7 business days from order confirmation.

Shipping Charges

  • Orders below ₹999 — ₹99 shipping charge
  • Orders ₹999 and above — Free Shipping

Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on your delivery location and order value.

Delivery Areas

We currently ship across India. Deliveries to remote or difficult-to-access areas may require additional transit time. International shipping is not yet available, but we are working towards offering it in the near future.

Order Updates

Currently, we do not offer live order tracking. However, we ensure that you stay informed at every step of your order journey — including order confirmation, processing, dispatch, and delivery — via email, SMS, and WhatsApp.

Please Note: Delivery timelines begin from the date of dispatch, not the date of order placement. During peak seasons or public holidays, slight delays may occur. We will always communicate any significant delays proactively.

We are actively working on introducing real-time tracking features to enhance your experience and will make this available soon. Thank you for your understanding and support. 🌿

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
At Shan Decors, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring a safe and secure online experience.

We collect basic personal information such as your name, contact details, shipping address, and order information to process purchases and provide customer support. We may also collect technical data, including your IP address and browsing activity, to improve our website performance and enhance your overall experience.

Your information is used solely for order fulfilment, communication, and service improvement. We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. However, we may share necessary information with trusted partners such as payment gateways and delivery providers to ensure secure and efficient order processing.

We implement standard security measures, including encryption and secure payment processing, to protect your data. While we strive to safeguard your information, please note that no method of transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

You have the right to access, update, or request deletion of your personal information, and to opt out of marketing communications at any time.

Our website may use cookies to enhance functionality and personalise your browsing experience. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings.

By using our website, you agree to the terms outlined in this Privacy Policy. We may update this policy from time to time, and any changes will be reflected on this page.

For any questions or concerns, please contact us at: shandecor01@gmail.com

about.title: Who We Are
about.body:
Shan Decors — Nature to Your Hands

Shan Decors was founded with a simple vision: to celebrate India's timeless craftsmanship while making it accessible to modern homes.

We partner with talented artisans across India — individuals who bring generations of skill, culture, and passion into every creation. Each piece is thoughtfully handmade, shaped with intention, and crafted with care — never mass-produced.

Our designs bring together traditional artistry and contemporary aesthetics, creating décor that feels meaningful, personal, and effortlessly refined.

At Shan Decors, we don't just create products — we preserve crafts, support artisan communities, and carry forward stories of heritage into everyday living spaces.

Your home deserves more than decoration. It deserves pieces that feel authentic, warm, and deeply yours.

Our Craft — Made by Hand. Made to Matter.

At the heart of everything we do is handcraft. No conveyor belts. No shortcuts. Every piece passes through the hands of makers who genuinely care about what they create.

Our specialisation in lamp shades has given us a deep understanding of light, form, and texture — how a single piece can transform not just a room, but the way it feels. These principles guide everything we design, from subtle decorative accents to statement pieces that quietly become the soul of a space.

We also offer fully customised creations, working closely with you to shape something that reflects your space, your taste, and your story — perfectly.

The Values Behind Every Piece

  • Handmade, Always — Every product is crafted by hand, from the first idea to the final finish. We choose time, care, and craftsmanship over speed, always.
  • Thoughtful Design — We design with intention, balancing beauty with purpose, ensuring every piece enhances the space it becomes a part of.
  • Uncompromised Quality — From material selection to the smallest detail, quality is never an afterthought. We take the time to get it right — because your home deserves nothing less.
  • Personal Customisation — We believe the best spaces are personal. Our bespoke approach allows you to co-create pieces that truly belong to you and your home.

From Lamp Shades to Full Living Spaces

Our journey began with handcrafted lamp shades — designed not just to light a space, but to create an atmosphere. Each shade is carefully made to cast a warm, layered glow that brings comfort, depth, and character into a room.

Over time, this understanding of light and texture has shaped our entire design philosophy. Today, our collection extends beyond lamp shades to include decorative accents, tabletop pieces, wall décor, and select furniture — each one handcrafted, each one designed to complement the spaces they enter.

"We don't make products to fill shelves. We create pieces to fill spaces with meaning — to become the details people notice, remember, and feel at home with."

A Note from Us

Shan Decors is still growing, learning, and evolving — and every step of this journey is made possible because of you.

Your support allows us to continue doing what we believe in: supporting artisans, preserving craftsmanship, and creating pieces that carry heart and intention.

We're truly grateful to have you as a part of our story.
